conventions.layerName: Paper layer name is canonical. Variants use a dot suffix (OBSetRow.done). A block may map to a shared widget or an inline composition; the Dart owner need not match the Paper name.
conventions.canonical: The node on the Bausteine page is canonical. Screens contain clones; a visual change is made on the Bausteine node first, then re-applied to the widget, then screens are re-derived.
conventions.package: Existing ui2 code is reused — not every Paper block is a class in lib/openband. implementationStatus is explicit when the block is not in source; absent status means implemented when file and widget resolve.
conventions.honesty: Absent input renders as — or is omitted. Lower-bound totals are not marked with ≥; the kcal bar shows a dashed unknown segment instead.
conventions.sourceCheck: tool/check_design_manifest.py verifies that implemented file/widget references exist in source. It does not verify routing or visual acceptance.

blocks.name: OBNightSignalChart.info

blocks.name: OBSettingsRow.toggle

Einrichtung · Willkommen / Band verbinden / Erste Übertragung / Dein Profil (ui2/onboarding)
status.hostWiring: app.dart: four tabs use the OpenBand hubs; Laufen tile → OpenBandRunLive over AppState (single live engine, _LiveRunFeed); templates → OpenBandStrengthLive via startStrengthSession(AppState.startWorkout); meals → OBFoodSearchSheet → showOpenBandMealDraft. Live route map (flutter_map, CARTO tiles) renders only with mapTilesAllowed; laps are recorded via recordLap and frozen into the session snapshot.

nightSignals.decision: Alpin 3 remains the visual contract. Borrow compact metric context and clear trace hierarchy. Keep stored HRV uncertainty and refuse to connect samples across unsupported timing gaps.
